name: @agentproto/skill-pack-agentpush
description: @agentproto/skill-pack-agentpush — the agentpush-plugin skill pack (the agentpush ⇄ agentproto transmitter: inbound/outbound message routing across Telegram/WhatsApp/Slack/generic webhooks, contact→session binding, credential brokering). Source of truth for both the Claude Code plugin bundle (.claude-plugin/plugin.json + skills/) and `agentproto install skill/<slug> --pack agentpush-plugin`. Edit src/skills/*, never skills/ or .claude-plugin/ directly — those are generated by `pnpm build`.
